sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Define the six trigonometric ratios for a right-angled triangle.

sections.title: The Six Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define sine, cosine, tangent, cosecant, secant, and cotangent.
Identify the opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse sides in a right-angled triangle relative to an angle.
sections.renderer_reasoning: This topic involves defining mathematical ratios and showing their relationship to the sides of a right-angled triangle, which Manim is excellent at visualizing with dynamic labels and diagrams.

sections.title: Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities

Apply reciprocal identities to simplify expressions.

sections.title: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Ratio
learning_goals: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find missing sides of a right triangle.

sections.title: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality

sections.title: Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions
learning_goals: Evaluate expressions involving squares of trigonometric ratios.
Understand and apply the Pythagorean identity (cos²θ + sin²θ = 1).
sections.renderer_reasoning: This example focuses on algebraic manipulation of trigonometric expressions and identities, which Manim can present clearly with step-by-step calculations.

sections.title: Verifying Trigonometric Identities
